sources.snippet: Parakeet CTC 1.1B (ONNX) Production-ready ONNX conversion of nvidia/parakeet-ctc-1.1b for speech-to-text inference — converted for edge deployment via Edgework.ai. Highlights State-of-the-art ASR — FastConformer encoder + CTC decoder 1.1B parameters — maximum accuracy variant of the Parakeet family Trained on 64K hours of English speech (NVIDIA NeMo + Suno.ai) No autoregressive decoding ...
